title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode1 What Happened to SEKAI?!

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What did you think of our performance?!
I hope you grow even bigger after hearing it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Umm... Does music really make trees grow bigger?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It totally does!
Ichi said that lots of different types of plants grow by listening to music!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe♪ The leaves sparkle so beautifully every time we give it water like this!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And it's grown so big.
What if it just keeps getting taller and taller...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
How fun would that be?!
Hehehe. Grow big and strong♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm also done sprinkling the coffee grounds that MEIKO gave me! If only there were someone here to praise me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But there's no one else here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, no matter! I'll just head back and brag to Miku about this♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'm glad you're doing so well now.
And those black fragments from the other day haven't reappeared...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you were born out of those girls' feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I hope you keep growing nice and healthy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm glad everything seems okay now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, were you taking a peek at those other SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I was...!
Remember what happened to them recently?
That all seemed like quite an ordeal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've actually been checking from time to time because I was worried that something similar would happen again...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're talking about the black fragments that made everyone fall asleep, right? That also really startled me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too!
I honestly thought that they'd never wake up again!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But what they experienced seems to have made them all a little stronger.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. Their bonds have become more resilient now that they've acknowledged their precious feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those trees and their feelings must be connected together at a very deep level.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know what's going to happen moving forward, but I hope they keep growing alongside everyone's feelings...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a very good question. I don't know either...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, what if something is happening to each of their SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean something bad is happening...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did the us in those other SEKAI just disappear...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's go take a look, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I don't know what just happened...
But we may be able to help.
